## Download

Download the `-setup.exe` below and run it. Tsundoku installs for your account only, so it needs no administrator rights. On first start, it finds yt-dlp, ffmpeg and Deno if you have them, or downloads them.

- **Windows protected your PC**: the installer isn't code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Updating**: Tsundoku checks for a new version when it starts and offers to install it. Running a newer installer over it works too. Your history, presets and settings are kept.
- **Uninstalling**: from Windows' Settings > Apps. Your history, settings and Tsundoku's copies of the tools stay, unless you tick **Delete the application data**.
- **Requirements**: Windows 11, 64-bit. Windows 10 should work, but hasn't been tested.

See the [README](https://github.com/Fuzen777/Tsundoku#readme) for what the app does, and the [changelog](https://github.com/Fuzen777/Tsundoku/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
